Henry Thomas Smart: hymns in Tonic Solfa

Henry Thomas Smart (1813–1879) · Composer

5 hymns and 4 hymn tunes on NoteFusion credit Henry Thomas Smart. Each is written out in Tonic Solfa under the words, with staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.
